data.text: Now I'll run a SQL query to count the number of distinct orders placed in Q1 2018 (January to March).

args.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as q1_2018_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' 
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01'
args.purpose: Count distinct orders placed in Q1 2018 (January-March)
